```{r setup, echo = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(survivoR)
library(forcats)
library(ggthemes)
library(randomForest)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)

```

Data Cleaning
```{r}
castaway_full <- merge(x = castaways, y = castaway_details)

#Removing all NAs for personality types from dataset.
castaway_filtered <- castaway_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(personality_type))

castaway_filtered <- castaway_filtered[,c(1,2,4,5,7,15,17,18,19,31,36,37,38,39,40)]

#Deleting seasons 48 and 50 since 49 already didn't include personality types.
castaway_50 <- castaway_filtered %>%
  filter(version_season == "US50")

castaway_filtered <- castaway_filtered %>%
  filter(!version_season == "US50")

castaway_48 <- castaway_filtered %>%
  filter(version_season == "US48")

castaway_filtered <- castaway_filtered %>%
  filter(!version == "AU")

castaway_filtered <- castaway_filtered %>%
  filter(!version_season == "US48")
#Only 855 rows remain after data cleaning. We started with 1378.

castaway_filtered <- castaway_filtered %>%
  arrange(castaway_id)


model <- lm(finalist ~ age + gender + lgbt + personality_type + collar + bipoc, data = castaway_filtered)

```


Prediction Model
```{r}
#Setup
Model_Train <- sample(1:nrow(castaway_filtered), 0.7 * nrow(castaway_filtered))
training_data <- castaway_filtered[Model_Train,]
testing_data <- castaway_filtered[-Model_Train,]

#Model
rand_for <- randomForest(finalist ~ age + gender + lgbt + personality_type + collar + bipoc, data = training_data)

#Testing
accurate_hopefully <- predict(rand_for, testing_data)
counter <- accurate_hopefully > 0.2
factored <- as.factor(counter)
leveled <- as.factor(testing_data$finalist)
IDK <- confusionMatrix(factored, leveled)

#48 Test
season48 <- predict(rand_for, castaway_48)
factor48 <- as.factor(season48 > 0.2)
frame48 <- data.frame(factor48)

tested_48 <- cbind(castaway_48, frame48)

#50 Test
season50 <- predict(rand_for, castaway_50)
factor50 <- as.factor(season50 > 0.2)
frame50 <- data.frame(factor50)

tested_50 <- cbind(castaway_50, frame50)
```

```{r}
#graph
frame <- as.data.frame(as.table(IDK))

ggplot(data = frame, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlGn") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq))
```
